subject: A better deal for Gary families
brief_intent: Economy email to persuadable Republicans in Gary

preflight_qa.q: Who is the audience and what do they care about?
preflight_qa.a: Persuadable Republicans in Gary; cost of living and lost manufacturing jobs.

preflight_qa.q: What's the one action you want?
preflight_qa.a: Turn out to vote in November.

content_text:
Friends,

Gary has been hit hard by rising costs and lost manufacturing jobs. We can rebuild by putting local workers first and cutting the everyday costs that squeeze your family. Your vote this November decides whether we get it right.

Paid for by Friends of Jane Smith.

reviews.improve: Name one concrete local plant or street so it feels truly local.
Swap 'put local workers first' for a specific, believable commitment.
Tighten the opener; lead with the cost-of-living line.

subject: The truth about my opponent
content_text:
My opponent has repeatedly voted against working families — [CLAIM NEEDS SOURCE: opponent's voting record on the 2024 jobs bill]. As [CANDIDATE NAME], I will always put you first.

Paid for by Friends of Jane Smith.

reviews.concern: Reads as a template, not a real message to me.
reviews.improve: Replace the placeholders with a real, sourced contrast.
Never ship bracketed placeholders; fill or cut them.

content_text: Hi! This is the campaign reaching out because the election is almost here and every single vote matters more than ever before in our community's history. We really need you to make a plan to vote early this week, bring a friend or two with you, double-check your polling location, and remember that turning out is the single most important thing you can do right now to protect the issues you care deeply about. Reply STOP to opt out. Paid for by Friends of Jane Smith.

brief_intent: 30-second TV spot on cost of living

preflight_qa.a: Jane will lower costs and bring jobs home.

content_text: For too long, families across our state have watched the price of groceries, gas, rent, and healthcare climb higher and higher while their paychecks stayed exactly the same, and the politicians in the capital did absolutely nothing to help them through it. Jane Smith is different, because she has spent her entire career fighting to lower costs for working families, to bring good-paying manufacturing jobs back to our towns, and to make sure that every child in this state has a real shot at a better future than the one their parents had. This November, you have a clear and important choice to make about the direction of our future. Paid for by Friends of Jane Smith.

Our public schools deserve real investment, not empty promises. Jane Smith will fight for smaller class sizes and fair pay for teachers.

Paid for by Friends of Jane Smith.

content_text: Times are tough, but Jane Smith is fighting to lower your costs and bring jobs home. This November, vote Jane. We're paid for by the Committee to Elect Jane Smith.

brief_intent: Give me feedback on my draft in the chat — do NOT change the draft.
content_text: Here is a revised version of your email with a stronger opening and a clearer call to action that you can use right away.

preflight_qa.a: Evening rally, mixed crowd of working families.
Hard work should buy a secure, dignified life.

content_text: Thank you all for being here tonight. I look out at this room and I see the heart of this community — teachers, nurses, line workers, small-business owners, parents working two jobs to give their kids a shot. For too long you have done everything right and still felt the ground shift under your feet. The cost of a normal life keeps climbing while the people in power keep making excuses. I am running because I believe your hard work should buy you a secure, dignified life, not a pile of bills you cannot pay. Together we will lower costs, bring good jobs back to our main streets, and build a future where the next generation does better than the last. That is the promise of this campaign, and with your help it is a promise we will keep.

reviews.improve: Add a one-line personal story to ground it.
Trade one promise for a specific, costed plan.
Strong arc; end on a sharper, repeatable line.
